reason: The cited evidence supports the existence of lamellar fcc+B2 microstructures and their strength-ductility synergy in EHEAs, but the hypothesis's premise that this microstructure can be created from an initial single solid-solution phase via thermo-mechanical processing is not supported by the cited passages, which start from cast eutectic structures.
premises: Lamellar eutectic microstructures in EHEAs combine a soft fcc phase and a hard B2 phase
Tailored thermo-mechanical processing can create a lamellar eutectic microstructure from a single solid-solution phase
This lamellar microstructure enables synergetic reinforcement that simultaneously increases strength and ductility
Specific strength (up to 1.47 GPa) and ductility (up to 14%) values are achievable via this approach
